exact_quantity: For each of the eleven possible contenders: is sigma(Phi_i) contained in sigma(B_t) on the causally available structural domain? If not, identify a legal nonredundancy witness and the additional observable read set. This is structural measurability, not empirical conditional dependence or predictive strength.
first_shared_blocker: The mapping from each proposed extra-information feature Phi_i to its own-information baseline B_t is not formally specified. Incremental information cannot be identified until deterministic baseline redundancy is excluded.

known_exact_redundancy.proof: The first proposal uses completed hourly high-low price location, and its frozen own-information baseline explicitly contains hourly price location. Hence Phi is already B-measurable. This blocks only the exact proposal, not the source family.

minimum_claim_scope: Smallest first-stage logical discriminator, not a proven globally minimal guaranteed winner-producing dataset. Multiple contenders can remain; no promised unique winner.
why_first: Every surviving candidate lacks an exact incremental identification certificate; more bars cannot specify a missing estimand or baseline. Addressing this necessary gate precedes support sampling or price history.
